database_scope: fresh temporary PostgreSQL 16 container with no mounted volumes
connection_scope: random host port bound to 127.0.0.1 only
tenant_context: synthetic fixture function; signed-context cryptography is covered separately
checks: tenant-qualified create creates a Gateway-owned draft and audit event
draft edit is reasoned and atomically appended
independent verifier and publisher can complete the governed lifecycle
organization/location grants deny a different tenant
cross-tenant updates are denied by the row guard
runtime role has read-only access to the append-only ledger
append-only trigger rejects mutation even when table UPDATE is temporarily granted
optional Directus cannot access the ledger and runtime cannot insert
